0001045810-26-000021:6:0.text: Competition could adversely impact our market share and financial results.

0001045810-26-000021:6:1.text: Our target markets remain competitive, and competition may intensify with expanding and changing product and service offerings, industry standards, customer and market needs, new entrants and consolidations.

0001045810-26-000021:6:2.text: Our competitors’ products, services and technologies, including those mentioned above in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, may be cheaper or provide better functionality or features than ours, which has resulted and may in the future result in lower-than-expected selling prices or demand for our products.

0001045810-26-000021:6:3.text: Some of our competitors operate their own fabrication facilities, and have longer operating histories, larger customer bases, more comprehensive IP portfolios and patent protections, more design wins, and greater financial, sales, marketing and distribution resources than we do.

0001045810-26-000021:6:4.text: These competitors may be able to acquire market share and/or prevent us from doing so, more effectively identify and capitalize upon opportunities in new markets and end-user trends, more quickly transition their products, and impinge on our ability to procure sufficient foundry capacity and scarce input materials during a supply-constrained environment, which could harm our business.

0001045810-26-000021:6:5.text: Some of our customers have in-house expertise and internal development capabilities similar to some of ours and can use or develop their own solutions to replace those we are providing.

0001045810-26-000021:6:6.text: For example, others may offer cloud-based services that compete with our AI cloud service offerings, and we may not be able to establish market share sufficient to achieve the scale necessary to meet our business objectives.

0001045810-26-000021:6:7.text: If we are unable to successfully compete in this environment, demand for our products, services and technologies could decrease, which may negatively impact our business.

0001045810-26-000021:7:0.text: Long manufacturing lead times and uncertain supply and capacity availability, combined with a failure to estimate customer demand accurately, has led and could lead to mismatches between supply and demand.

0001045810-26-000021:7:1.text: We have long manufacturing lead times and build finished products and maintain inventory in advance of anticipated demand.

0001045810-26-000021:7:10.text: Additionally, since some of our products are part of a complex data center buildout, supply constraints or availability issues with respect to any one component have had and may have a broader revenue impact.

0001045810-26-000021:7:11.text: For example, our ability to sell certain products has been and could be impeded if components necessary for the finished products are not available from third parties.

0001045810-26-000021:7:12.text: If we overestimate demand, or if customers cancel or defer orders or choose to purchase from our competitors, we may not be able to utilize on-hand inventory or reduce purchase commitments accordingly.

0001045810-26-000021:7:13.text: We have had to reduce average selling prices, including due to our channel pricing programs, increase prices for certain of our products as a result of our suppliers’ increase in prices, write down our inventory, incur cancellation penalties, and record impairments, and may have to do so in the future.

0001045810-26-000021:7:14.text: The impact of these risks would be amplified by our non-cancellable and non-returnable purchase orders placed in advance of our historical lead times and could be exacerbated if we need to make changes to the design of future products.

0001045810-26-000021:7:15.text: These risks have increased and may continue to increase as our purchase obligations and prepaids have grown and are expected to continue to grow and become a greater portion of our total supply.

0001045810-26-000021:7:16.text: All of these factors may negatively impact our gross margins and financial results.

0001045810-26-000021:7:17.text: Factors that have caused and/or could in the future cause us to underestimate or overestimate demand, and impact the timing and volume of our revenue, include:

0001045810-26-000021:7:18.text: changes in product development cycles and time to market;

0001045810-26-000021:7:19.text: competing technologies and competitor product releases, announcements or other actions;

0001045810-26-000021:7:2.text: In periods of shortages impacting the semiconductor industry and/or limited supply or capacity in our supply chain, the lead times for certain supply may be extended.

0001045810-26-000021:7:20.text: changes in business and economic conditions;

0001045810-26-000021:7:21.text: sudden or sustained government lockdowns or public health issues;

0001045810-26-000021:7:22.text: rapidly changing technology or customer requirements;

0001045810-26-000021:7:23.text: the availability of sufficient data center capacity or energy for customers to procure;

0001045810-26-000021:7:24.text: new product introductions and transitions resulting in less demand for existing products;

0001045810-26-000021:7:26.text: increase in demand for competitive products;

0001045810-26-000021:7:28.text: purchasing decisions made, and inventory levels held by, distributors, ODMs, OEMs, system integrators, other channel partners and other third parties;

0001045810-26-000021:7:29.text: the ability of developers, end customers and other third parties to build, enhance, and maintain accelerated computing applications that leverage our platforms;

0001045810-26-000021:7:3.text: We have previously experienced and may continue to experience extended lead times of more than 12 months.

0001045810-26-000021:7:30.text: the demand for accelerated computing, AI-related cloud services, or large language models;

0001045810-26-000021:7:31.text: changes that impact the ecosystem for the architectures underlying our products and technologies;

0001045810-26-000021:7:32.text: government actions or changes in governmental policies, such as export controls, increased restrictions on gaming usage, or tariffs;

0001045810-26-000021:7:33.text: our customers’ and partners’ ability to secure capital and energy and to build complex datacenter infrastructure timely; and •the availability of third-party content on our platforms, such as GeForce NOW.

0001045810-26-000021:7:34.text: The availability of data centers, energy, and capital to support the buildout of NVIDIA AI infrastructure by our customers and partners is crucial, and any shortage of these and other necessary resources could impact our future revenue and financial performance.

0001045810-26-000021:7:35.text: Expanding energy capacity to meet demand is a complex, multi-year process involving significant regulatory, technical, and construction challenges.

0001045810-26-000021:7:36.text: In addition, access to capital can be particularly constrained for less-capitalized companies, which may face difficulties securing financing for large-scale infrastructure projects.

0001045810-26-000021:7:37.text: These limitations could delay customer and partner deployments or reduce the scale of accelerated computing and AI adoption.

0001045810-26-000021:7:38.text: Challenges in estimating demand could become more pronounced or volatile in the future on both a global and regional basis.

0001045810-26-000021:7:39.text: Extended lead times may occur if we experience other supply constraints caused by natural disasters, pandemics or other events.

0001045810-26-000021:7:4.text: To secure future supply and capacity, we have paid premiums, provided deposits, and entered into long-term supply agreements and capacity commitments, which have increased our product costs and this may continue.

0001045810-26-000021:7:40.text: Geopolitical tensions in regions where we rely on suppliers, contract manufacturers, and assembly partners that are critical to our supply continuity, could have a material adverse impact on us.

0001045810-26-000021:7:41.text: Publicly announced intentions by governments or other companies to purchase our products can further complicate our demand estimates, as such announcements are often non-binding and may not result in committed volumes.

0001045810-26-000021:7:42.text: We continue to increase our supply and capacity purchases with existing and new suppliers to support our demand projections and increasing complexity of our data center products.

0001045810-26-000021:7:43.text: We expect supply constraints to be a headwind to Gaming in the first quarter of fiscal year 2027 and beyond.

0001045810-26-000021:7:44.text: We have also entered and may continue to enter into prepaid manufacturing and capacity agreements to supply both current and future products.

0001045810-26-000021:7:45.text: The increased purchase volumes and integration of new suppliers and contract manufacturers into our supply chain creates more complexity in managing multiple suppliers with variations in production planning, execution and logistics.

0001045810-26-000021:7:46.text: Our expanding product portfolio and varying component compatibility and quality may lead to increased inventory levels.

0001045810-26-000021:7:47.text: We have incurred and may in the future incur inventory provisions or impairments if our inventory or supply or capacity commitments exceed demand for our products or demand declines.

0001045810-26-000021:7:48.text: We are increasing our U.S.-based manufacturing and investing in specialized equipment and processes to support domestic production.

0001045810-26-000021:7:49.text: We may experience delays or difficulties in scaling production as planned.

0001045810-26-000021:7:5.text: We may still be unable to secure sufficient commitments for capacity to address our business needs.

0001045810-26-000021:7:50.text: Our ability to increase manufacturing capabilities will depend on the domestic manufacturing ecosystem's capacity to ramp production supply to the required volume timely.

0001045810-26-000021:7:51.text: Delays or shortfalls could impact our ability to meet demand.

0001045810-26-000021:7:52.text: Product transitions are complex and we often ship both new and prior architecture products simultaneously as our channel partners prepare to ship and support new products.

0001045810-26-000021:7:53.text: We are generally in various stages of transitioning the architectures of our Data Center, Gaming, Professional Visualization, and Automotive products.

0001045810-26-000021:7:54.text: The computing industry is experiencing a broader and faster launch cadence of accelerated computing platforms to meet a growing and diverse set of AI opportunities.

0001045810-26-000021:7:55.text: We have introduced a new product and architecture cadence of our Data Center solutions where we seek to complete new computing solutions each year and provide a greater variety of Data Center offerings.

0001045810-26-000021:7:56.text: The increased frequency of these transitions and the larger number of products and product configurations may magnify the challenges associated with managing our supply and demand which may further create volatility in our revenue.

0001045810-26-000021:7:57.text: Qualification time for new products, customers anticipating product transitions, and channel partners reducing channel inventory of prior architectures ahead of new product introductions can reduce, or create volatility in, our revenue.

0001045810-26-000021:7:58.text: Customers may delay adopting new architectures if their data center infrastructure is not ready, which could affect the timing of our revenue.

0001045810-26-000021:7:59.text: We have experienced and may in the future experience reduced demand for current generation architectures when customers anticipate transitions, and we may be unable to sell multiple product architectures at the same time for current and future architecture transitions.

0001045810-26-000021:7:6.text: If we inaccurately estimate demand, or our customers change orders, as we have experienced in the past, we may not be able to reduce our supply commitments in time, at the same rate, or at all.

0001045810-26-000021:7:60.text: Our financial results have been and may in the future be negatively impacted if we are unable to execute our architectural transitions as planned for any reason.

0001045810-26-000021:7:61.text: The increased frequency and complexity of newly introduced products could result in unanticipated quality or production issues that could increase the magnitude of inventory provisions, warranty, or other costs or result in product delays.

0001045810-26-000021:7:62.text: For example, our gross margins in the second quarter of fiscal year 2025 were negatively impacted by inventory provisions for low-yielding Blackwell material.

0001045810-26-000021:7:63.text: We incur significant engineering development resources for new products, and changes to our product roadmap may impact our ability to develop other products or adequately manage our supply chain cost.

0001045810-26-000021:7:64.text: Customers may delay purchasing existing products as we increase the frequency of new products or may not be able to adopt our new products as fast as forecasted, both impacting the timing of our revenue and supply chain cost.

0001045810-26-000021:7:65.text: While we have managed prior product transitions and have sold multiple product architectures at the same time, these transitions are difficult, may impair our ability to predict demand and impact our supply mix, and may cause us to incur additional costs.

0001045810-26-000021:7:66.text: Demand estimates for our products, applications, and services can be incorrect, which may create volatility in our revenue or supply levels.

0001045810-26-000021:7:67.text: We may not be able to generate significant revenue from them.

0001045810-26-000021:7:68.text: Because our products may be used in multiple use cases and applications, it is difficult to estimate with any reasonable degree of precision the impact of accelerated computing and AI models on our reported revenue or forecasted demand.

0001045810-26-000021:7:69.text: The use of our GPUs for new, mercurial, or trendy applications, has impacted and can impact in the future, demand for our products, including by leading to inconsistent spikes and drops in demand.

0001045810-26-000021:7:7.text: Significant mismatches between supply and demand have varied across our market platforms, resulted in both product shortages and excess inventory, significantly harmed our financial results and could reoccur.

0001045810-26-000021:7:70.text: For example, several years ago, our Gaming GPUs began to be used for mining digital currencies, such as Ethereum.

0001045810-26-000021:7:71.text: It is difficult for us to estimate with any reasonable degree of precision the past or current impact of cryptocurrency mining, or forecast the future impact of cryptocurrency mining, on demand for our products.

0001045810-26-000021:7:72.text: Volatility in the cryptocurrency market, including new compute technologies, price changes in cryptocurrencies, government cryptocurrency policies and regulations, new cryptocurrency standards and changes in the method of verifying blockchain transactions, has impacted and can in the future impact cryptocurrency mining and demand for our products and can further impact our ability to estimate demand for our products.

0001045810-26-000021:7:73.text: Changes to cryptocurrency standards and processes including, but not limited to, the Ethereum 2.0 merge in 2022, have reduced and may in the future decrease the usage of GPUs for Ethereum mining.

0001045810-26-000021:7:74.text: This has created and may in the future create increased aftermarket sales of our GPUs, which could negatively impact retail prices for our GPUs and reduce demand for our new GPUs.

0001045810-26-000021:7:75.text: In general, our new products or previously sold products may be resold online or on the unauthorized “gray market,” which also makes demand forecasting difficult.

0001045810-26-000021:7:76.text: Gray market products and reseller marketplaces compete with our new products and distribution channels.

0001045810-26-000021:7:77.text: Our inability to accurately predict our demand that arises from new use cases may create volatility in our revenue.

0001045810-26-000021:7:8.text: If we underestimate demand, and our foundry partners and contract manufacturers are unable to increase production or provide sufficient supply, we may not be able to meet increased customer demand in a timely manner, or at all.

0001045810-26-000021:7:9.text: Our reputation and customer relationships could be damaged and we could lose revenue and market share.

0001045810-26-000021:8:0.text: Dependency on third-party suppliers and their technology to manufacture, assemble, test, or package our products reduces our control over product quantity and quality, manufacturing yields, and product delivery schedules and could harm our business.

0001045810-26-000021:8:1.text: We depend on foundries to manufacture our semiconductor wafers using their fabrication equipment and techniques.

0001045810-26-000021:8:10.text: failure by our suppliers to comply with our policies and expectations and emerging regulatory requirements;

0001045810-26-000021:8:13.text: lack of direct control over product quantity, quality, and delivery schedules;

0001045810-26-000021:8:14.text: integration of new suppliers and contract manufacturers creating more complexity in managing multiple suppliers with variations in production planning, execution, and logistics;

0001045810-26-000021:8:15.text: suppliers or their suppliers failing to provide high quality products and/or making changes to their products without our qualification;

0001045810-26-000021:8:16.text: delays in product shipments, shortages, a decrease in product quality and/or higher expenses in the event our subcontractors or foundries prioritize our competitors’ or other customers’ orders over ours;

0001045810-26-000021:8:17.text: requirements to place orders that are not cancellable upon changes in demand or requirements to prepay for supply in advance;

0001045810-26-000021:8:18.text: low manufacturing yields resulting from issues in our product design or a foundry’s proprietary process technology;

0001045810-26-000021:8:19.text: suppliers extending lead times and/or increasing costs during shortages; and •disruptions in manufacturing, assembly and other processes due to closures related to heat waves, earthquakes, fires, or other natural disasters, electricity conservation efforts, pandemics, and cybersecurity incidents.

0001045810-26-000021:8:2.text: We do not assemble, test, or package our products, but instead contract with independent subcontractors.

0001045810-26-000021:8:4.text: We face risks which have adversely affected or could adversely affect our ability to meet customer demand and scale our supply chain, negatively impact longer-term demand for our products and services, and adversely affect our business operations, gross margin, revenue and/or financial results, including:
